description: This file implements authentication functionality for a Flask web application, including user registration, login, logout, and session management.

methods.name: login_required
methods.description: Decorator to ensure a user is logged in before accessing a view.

methods.name: load_logged_in_user
methods.description: Loads the logged-in user into g.user if session contains user_id.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration, including validation and password hashing.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login, verifying credentials and starting a session.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the session to log out the user.
